artifacts.description: handles to expose to the command as environment variables holding file paths, e.g. {"LOG": "blake3:…"} then `grep error "$LOG"`

cwd.description: relative to the driver's working directory

run.description: Run a shell command and return its exit status and output. The command is passed to `sh -c`, so pipes and redirection work — use them: `… 2>&1 | tail -40` keeps a long log out of the conversation. Output over ~16KB comes back as {handle, size, preview} — and you can feed such a handle straight back in through `artifacts` instead of reading it, which is almost always the cheaper move. The call blocks until the command ends or times out.
